description: In literal-only mode, the for_each string of a dynamic block nested in a block is still a template
notes: In literal-only mode, the spec reads JSON strings as literal text. hashicorp/hcl's JSON expressions read a string as a template whenever they are given an evaluation context (expression.Value in json/structure.go), and the dynamic blocks extension evaluates the for_each of dynamic blocks in any nested body with an evaluation context of its own (iteration.EvalContext in ext/dynblock/iteration.go), which it creates even when it was given none. Only a dynamic block in the file's body gets no context (see json/dynamic-blocks/literal-only-for-each-string-is-text).
